name: La Famiglia: The Great Mafia War

rounds.endCondition: Immediate win at end of any round on reaching the Mandamenti threshold; otherwise game ends after round 4

categories.label: Mandamenti controlled by the team
categories.labelVi: Số Mandamenti cả đội kiểm soát
categories.hint: A Mandamento (3 areas) is controlled by holding at least 2 of its 3 areas. Team of 2 families wins at 6.

categories.label: Most Mandamenti controlled by a single family
categories.labelVi: Số Mandamenti nhiều nhất của một gia đình
categories.hint: One family controlling 5 Mandamenti alone wins instantly.

categories.label: Team controls Bronte (tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Bronte is the area in the central Mandamento; decides a tie after round 4.

tiebreakers.description: After round 4 without an instant win, the team with more Mandamenti wins.
If Mandamenti are tied, the team controlling Bronte wins.

winCondition: Instant win at the end of any round if a single family controls 5 Mandamenti or a team controls 6. Otherwise after round 4 the team with more Mandamenti wins; on a tie, the team holding Bronte wins.

endCondition.description: Team reaches 6 Mandamenti (or one family 5) at end of a round; otherwise after round 4.

notes: family: area-majority. No victory points. 4 players only (2 vs 2). If tied and nobody holds Bronte, secondary sources imply a draw. Official English rulebook (BGG file 250311, login-walled) could not be downloaded; rules taken from agreeing reviews, so exact wording unverified.
